workloads.title: 1. Static scene, orbiting camera
workloads.description: No entity changes; the camera orbits the whole scene every frame.

workloads.title: 2. Localized animation (1% contiguous slice)
workloads.description: 100 contiguous tail entities move every frame.

workloads.title: 3. Entity churn (despawn + spawn)
workloads.description: 200 random entities despawned and as many spawned every frame.

workloads.title: 4. Deep zoom into the eye (frustum culling)
workloads.description: Camera tight on the cat's eye, jittered by 0.002 units each frame so culling reruns.

workloads.title: 5. Raycast picking
workloads.description: 50 pointer queries against every entity (overview camera).
notes: O3d hit an entity on 34/50 queries. Same entity as O3d: Three.js InstancedMesh (+ addUpdateRange): 40/50; Three.js InstancedMesh (needsUpdate): 40/50; JS scene graph (AoS objects): 47/50.
